what: Two texts stacked in one spot — when visible, the front text wipes in from the left (clip-path 1.2s cubic.out), then .4s later wipes out to the right while the back text wipes in from the left over the same length. An English section name stands briefly, then is swapped for the Korean name

options.dur · gap: Wipe duration · moment the previous text starts to disappear (seconds), default 1.2 · .4
options.on: With event, instead of scroll, fx:play is fired at the element (when the pinned section’s progress decides). fx:reset returns to the start
options.[data-fx-part=before] · [data-fx-part=af: Front text · back text (both required) — they overlap in the same cell

from.where: index.html section title (original data-title2-animation · Vt — weDo·flow·cases card titles, in pinned sections plays fx:play/fx:reset by progress)
